g.text: How the agent spent its token and turn budget
GRPO-style credit / custom IPO · job 190 · 2 optimizer updates · 32 accepted training traces
Dots show every accepted trace; boxes show median/IQR and 1.5×IQR whiskers. Truncation categories can overlap.
Sampled-action surprisal is −mean(behavior log p) on the loss mask, not vocabulary entropy. Task mix confounds reward correlations.
Source: recorded training.log + rollout JSON; compact data and input hashes in ../../metrics/rl-metrics.json.
Training-batch diagnostics only. These short runs do not establish convergence or held-out quality.
